Depth Pro 2 now runs in the browser on WebGPU.

I converted Apple's Depth Pro 2 (sizes S and B, plus the field-of-view model) to LiteRT, so it runs on the GPU through LiteRT.js. In Chrome on an M1 MacBook Pro, S takes about 320 ms a frame at 480x854 and B about 800 ms, in float16.

Demo, with your own photos or the webcam (nothing leaves your machine): https://huggingface.co/spaces/byoussef/DepthPro2-WebGPU

Files, JS and Python usage, and the export script: https://huggingface.co/byoussef/Depth…

socialPosts.rawContent:
CCORE Web Coder 4B is out with the full Safetensors weights!
https://huggingface.co/ccore/CCORE-Web-Coder-4B
Give it one prompt and see what a 4B model can build. A landing page, a pitch deck, or an infographic comes back as a single editable HTML file you can open in your browser.

The final checkpoint is also available in F16, Q8_0, and Q4_K_M GGUFs for local inference. The training dataset is coming November 25.
